strings.zh: 阿速『各位！回想一年前{NEWLINE}火箭队大闹关东和城都的时候,{CLEAR}在咱们桔梗市{CLEAR}也曾发生过一场激烈的战斗。{SCROLL}阿速『在那次战斗中{NEWLINE}我们的两位重要战友{CLEAR}——猫头夜鹰和大王燕,{CLEAR}为了保护市民的安全{CLEAR}奋勇向前、顽强不屈最终舍生取义……{SCROLL}阿速『如今火箭队已经解散,{NEWLINE}地区又重归和平安定,{CLEAR}但我们却不应忘记{CLEAR}为此献出了生命的战友们。

strings.zh: 我是来喇叭芽之塔修行的

strings.zh: 长老『施主请自便。

strings.zh: 长老『施主一看便是行家里手,{NEWLINE}能选我喇叭芽之塔修行,我辈深感荣幸。{SCROLL}长老『小僧参研佛法之余,{NEWLINE}常以对战强身健体,{CLEAR}不知施主可有兴趣指点小僧一二？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Elder: One look tells me you are a{NEWLINE}true expert, traveler. That you{CLEAR}chose our Sprout Tower for your{CLEAR}training is an honor to us all.{SCROLL}Elder: Besides studying the Dharma,{NEWLINE}this humble monk often battles to{CLEAR}keep his body strong. Would you{CLEAR}care to give me a lesson or two?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 长老『阿弥陀佛,施主请接招吧。
strings.en: Elder: Amitabha. Traveler, have at you.

strings.zh: 长老『阿弥陀佛,{NEWLINE}真是自古英雄出少年。
strings.en: Elder: Amitabha. Truly, heroes{NEWLINE}have always come from the young.

strings.en: Elder: You carry only one{NEWLINE}Pokémon, traveler. How could{CLEAR}this humble monk gang up on you?

strings.zh: 长老『阿弥陀佛,{NEWLINE}施主有心向佛,足见慧根不浅。{CLEAR}我这里有经书两部,{CLEAR}不知施主想听哪一部？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Elder: Amitabha. Your heart turns{NEWLINE}toward the Buddha, traveler,{CLEAR}which shows your roots of wisdom{CLEAR}run deep. I have two sutras here.{CLEAR}Which would you like to hear?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 颂读金刚经,5000元
strings.en: Diamond Sutra $5000

strings.zh: 颂读大悲咒,5000元
strings.en: Compassion Mantra $5000

strings.zh: 为什么颂经还要花钱？

strings.zh: 算了不听了
strings.en: Never mind

strings.zh: 长老『阿弥陀佛,{NEWLINE}经不可轻传、不可轻取呀。{CLEAR}相传旧时众僧下塔,{CLEAR}将经文在缘朱市铃铛塔颂念一遍,{CLEAR}只讨得三个树果为谢。{CLEAR}我说他们卖的便宜了,{CLEAR}让塔上僧人无以谋生。{CLEAR}我喇叭芽之塔僧人吃穿用度、{CLEAR}古塔修理维护,无一处不用钱财,{CLEAR}若是如旧时那般传经,{CLEAR}我等生活便难以为继了。
strings.en: Elder: Amitabha. Scripture must not be{NEWLINE}handed out lightly, nor taken lightly.{SCROLL}Elder: Legend has it that long ago,{NEWLINE}monks came down from this tower{CLEAR}and chanted the scriptures once at{CLEAR}the Bell Tower in Ecruteak City, and{CLEAR}asked only three Berries in thanks.{SCROLL}Elder: I say they sold them far{NEWLINE}too cheap, and left the monks of{CLEAR}this tower with nothing to live on.{SCROLL}Elder: Food, robes, daily needs, the{NEWLINE}repair and upkeep of this ancient{CLEAR}tower... The monks of Sprout{CLEAR}Tower need money for all of it.{SCROLL}Elder: If we passed on scripture{NEWLINE}the way they did in the old{CLEAR}days, we could not get by.
strings.notes: Parodies Journey to the West (Buddha: scripture 'sold too cheap' for three measures of rice-gold); here three Berries at Ecruteak's Bell Tower.

strings.zh: 长老『阿弥陀佛,{NEWLINE}「金刚般若波罗蜜经」。{CLEAR}一时佛在舍卫国。{CLEAR}纸树给孤独园。{CLEAR}与大比丘众。{CLEAR}千二百五十人俱。{CLEAR}尔时世尊。{CLEAR}食时。著衣持钵。{CLEAR}入舍卫大城祈食。{CLEAR}于其城中。次第祈已。还至本处。{CLEAR}饭食毕。收衣钵。洗足已。覆座而坐。{SCROLL}…………{SCROLL}…………
strings.en: Elder: Amitabha. ‘The Diamond{NEWLINE}Sutra.’ At one time the Buddha dwelt{CLEAR}in Shravasti, in the Jeta Grove, in the{CLEAR}garden of the Benefactor of the Lonely,{CLEAR}with a great assembly of 1,250 monks.{SCROLL}Elder: At mealtime, the World-Honored{NEWLINE}One put on his robe, took up his{CLEAR}bowl and entered the great city{CLEAR}of Shravasti to beg for food.{SCROLL}Elder: Having begged from house{NEWLINE}to house, he returned. When{CLEAR}he had eaten, he put away his{CLEAR}robe and bowl, washed his feet,{CLEAR}arranged his seat and sat down.{SCROLL}......{SCROLL}......
strings.notes: Diamond Sutra opening, translated from the zh (zh typos 纸树/祈食 for 祇树/乞食). Religious text, not song lyrics.

strings.zh: 长老『阿弥陀佛,{NEWLINE}「广大圆满无碍大悲心陀罗尼」。{CLEAR}拿磨喝拉达努多拉夜耶,{CLEAR}拿磨哦利耶,{CLEAR}婆卢杰帝说波拉耶,{CLEAR}普提萨多婆耶,{CLEAR}摩呵萨多婆耶,{CLEAR}摩呵加卢尼加耶,{SCROLL}…………{SCROLL}…………
strings.en: Elder: Amitabha. ‘The Great Compassion{NEWLINE}Dharani.’ Namo ratna-trayaya, namo{CLEAR}arya-valokiteshvaraya, bodhisattvaya,{CLEAR}mahasattvaya, mahakarunikaya...{SCROLL}......{SCROLL}......
strings.notes: Opening of the Great Compassion Dharani; zh is a Chinese transliteration, rendered in romanised Sanskrit without diacritics.

strings.zh: 长老『阿弥陀佛,{NEWLINE}施主身上所带钱财并未够数。
strings.en: Elder: Amitabha. Traveler, you do{NEWLINE}not have enough money with you.

strings.zh: 长老『一切世间天人阿修罗。{NEWLINE}闻佛所说。皆大欢喜。信受奉行。
strings.en: Elder: ...And all the world’s{NEWLINE}gods, humans and asuras, hearing{CLEAR}what the Buddha had taught,{CLEAR}rejoiced greatly, and believed,{CLEAR}accepted and practiced it.
strings.notes: Closing formula of the Diamond Sutra.

strings.zh: 长老『阿弥陀佛,颂经已毕。
strings.en: Elder: Amitabha. The{NEWLINE}chanting is complete.

strings.zh: 长老『缩婆呵,昂悉殿都。{NEWLINE}漫多罗,拔陀耶,缩婆呵。
strings.en: Elder: ...Svaha. Om siddhyantu{NEWLINE}mantra padaya svaha.
strings.notes: Closing phrases of the Great Compassion Dharani (romanised Sanskrit).

strings.zh: 阿速『咳,下面请桔梗市市民代表{NEWLINE}敬献花圈。

strings.en: Falkner: Miss Whitney, you need{NEWLINE}not blame yourself. Swellow{CLEAR}made saving people its duty and{CLEAR}charged forward without fear of{CLEAR}death. That shows it lived up to{CLEAR}everything we raised it to be.

strings.zh: 长老『对于飞行系精灵来说,{NEWLINE}让它们安息在离天空最近的高塔上,{CLEAR}象征着在它们死后{CLEAR}灵魂和身体依然能够在天空中翱翔。{CLEAR}这是对它们生前贡献的最高认可。
